content: 1. Ofloxacin: Ofloxacin reduces the levels or effects of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral hormone forms. The risk of contraceptive failure is low. Caution and monitoring are advised. 2.
